data.one_liner: Flutter debug overlay for real-time inspection of HTTP requests and WebSockets.
data.what_it_does: Thunder is a debug overlay for Flutter apps that intercepts and monitors `package:http` requests and `web_socket_channel` WebSockets in real time. It provides a slide-out panel with detailed logs, headers, response views, session timelines, and curl command generation.
use_when: You want to inspect HTTP network traffic and WebSockets directly inside your Flutter app during development
You need an easy slide-out debug overlay panel to search and filter network calls
avoid_when: You are using a networking library other than package:http or web_socket_channel that doesn't support the provided middleware
You need network inspection in production builds (Thunder is intended for debug mode only)
strengths: Monitors both HTTP requests and WebSockets with timeline tracking
Includes search, filter, and clear log features
Platform support across Android, iOS, Web, macOS, Linux, and Windows
weaknesses: Requires Flutter >= 3.47.0 and Dart >= 3.13.0 for version 2.x
Limited to package:http-based clients and web_socket_channel
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml, wrap your app root widget with Thunder, and plug Thunder.middleware into your HTTP client.
